points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 茅盾原名沈德鸿，字雁冰，1896年7月4日出生于浙江桐乡乌镇的一个书香门第。父亲沈永锡是清末秀才，母亲陈爱珠也知书达理。茅盾自幼受到良好的家庭教育，广泛阅读古典文学，奠定了深厚的文学功底。这段时期的启蒙教育培养了他对文学的热爱，也塑造了他关注社会现实的思维模式。1907年，茅盾进入当地小学学习，1911年考入嘉兴府中学堂，开始接触新思想。
points.descriptionEn: Born as Shen Dehong in Tongxiang, Zhejiang, Mao Dun grew up in a scholarly family with strong literary traditions. His father Shen Yongxi was a scholar in the late Qing Dynasty, and his mother Chen Aizhu was also well-educated. During this formative period, Mao Dun received a classical education that nurtured his love for literature and shaped his social consciousness. He attended local schools and later entered Jiaxing Prefectural Middle School in 1911, where he was first exposed to new ideas.

points.title: 新文化运动
points.description: 1916年，茅盾进入上海商务印书馆工作，开始接触新文化运动。在此期间，他积极参与《学生杂志》的编辑工作，翻译介绍外国文学作品，特别是俄国和东欧文学。1920年，茅盾加入上海共产主义小组，成为中国共产党的早期党员。他参与创办《共产党》月刊，撰写了大量宣传马克思主义的文章。这一时期，茅盾的思想从改良主义转向革命，文学创作也开始关注社会现实问题。
points.descriptionEn: In 1916, Mao Dun joined the Commercial Press in Shanghai, where he became involved in the New Culture Movement. He worked as an editor for 'Student Magazine' and translated foreign literary works, particularly from Russia and Eastern Europe. In 1920, he joined the Shanghai Communist Group, becoming an early member of the Communist Party of China. During this period, he co-founded 'The Communist' magazine and wrote extensively to promote Marxist ideas, marking his transition from reformism to revolution.

points.title: 文学创作起步
points.description: 1921年，茅盾与郑振铎、叶圣陶等人共同发起成立文学研究会，倡导'为人生的艺术'。这一时期，他创作了《幻灭》《动摇》《追求》三部曲，反映大革命前后知识分子的思想变化。1925年，茅盾担任《小说月报》主编，将这份文学刊物改造为当时中国最重要的文学阵地之一。他大力提倡现实主义文学，翻译介绍外国进步文学，培养了一批青年作家。这一阶段是茅盾文学创作和理论建设的重要时期，奠定了他在中国现代文学史上的地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1921, Mao Dun co-founded the Literary Research Association with Zheng Zhenduo and Ye Shengtao, advocating for 'art for life's sake.' During this period, he created his 'Trilogy' ('Disillusionment,' 'Wavering,' and 'Pursuit'), reflecting the ideological changes among intellectuals before and after the Great Revolution. As editor of 'Fiction Monthly' from 1925, he transformed the magazine into one of China's most important literary platforms, promoting realistic literature and introducing progressive foreign works, while mentoring young writers.

points.title: 流亡创作
points.description: 1927年大革命失败后，茅盾因政治原因被迫流亡日本。在日本期间，他完成了代表作《子夜》的创作，这部作品以上海为背景，深刻反映了中国民族资产阶级的命运和当时的社会矛盾。同时，他还创作了《蚀》三部曲和《虹》等作品，展现了知识分子的精神探索。在日本流亡期间，茅盾深入研究了马克思主义文艺理论，形成了自己独特的文学观。这段经历丰富了他的创作视野，使他的作品更加深刻地反映社会现实。
points.descriptionEn: Following the failure of the Great Revolution in 1927, Mao Dun went into exile in Japan due to political reasons. During his stay, he completed his masterpiece 'Midnight,' set in Shanghai, which profoundly depicted the fate of China's national bourgeoisie and contemporary social contradictions. He also wrote the 'Erosion' trilogy and 'Rainbow,' exploring the spiritual journey of intellectuals. This period allowed him to study Marxist literary theory in depth, shaping his unique literary perspective and enriching his creative vision.

points.title: 抗战文学
points.description: 1931年茅盾回到上海，正值日本侵华加剧。他积极参与抗日救亡运动，创作了大量反映抗战现实的文学作品，如《春蚕》《秋收》《残冬》农村三部曲和《腐蚀》等。1936年，他与巴金、老舍等人发起成立'中国文艺家协会'，团结进步作家共同抗日。抗战期间，他还担任《文艺阵地》主编，培养了一批抗战文学新人。这一时期，茅盾的文学创作与民族命运紧密相连，他的作品成为鼓舞人民抗战精神的重要力量。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to Shanghai in 1931 as Japanese aggression intensified, Mao Dun actively participated in the anti-Japanese resistance movement. He created numerous works reflecting wartime reality, including the rural trilogy 'Silkworms,' 'Autumn Harvest,' and 'Winter Remains,' as well as 'Corrosion.' In 1936, he co-founded the Chinese Writers' Association with Ba Jin and Lao She to unite progressive writers against Japanese invasion. During the war, he edited 'Literary Front' and mentored new writers, with his works becoming an important force in inspiring the nation's resistance spirit.

points.title: 文化领导
points.description: 新中国成立后，茅盾迁居北京，担任文化部副部长、中国作家协会主席等职，成为中国文学界的重要领导人。他致力于社会主义文学建设，提出'百花齐放，百家争鸣'的文艺方针。1958年，他创作了长篇小说《锻炼》，反映社会主义建设。文革期间，茅盾受到冲击，但仍然坚持文学创作和研究。1978年后，他积极参与拨乱反正工作，推动文学艺术的恢复与发展。1981年3月27日，茅盾在北京逝世，临终前捐出25万元设立'茅盾文学奖'，成为中国文学界最高荣誉之一。
points.descriptionEn: After the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949, Mao Dun moved to Beijing and served as Vice Minister of Culture and Chairman of the Chinese Writers' Association, becoming a leading figure in China's literary circles. He dedicated himself to building socialist literature and proposed the policy of 'let a hundred flowers bloom, let a hundred schools of thought contend.' In 1958, he wrote the novel 'Tempering' reflecting socialist construction. During the Cultural Revolution, he faced persecution but continued writing and research. After 1978, he actively participated in the rectification campaign, promoting the recovery and development of literature and art. On March 27, 1981, Mao Dun passed away in Beijing, establishing the Mao Dun Literature Prize with his savings, China's highest literary honor.

supporter.zh: 茅盾是中国现代文学的重要奠基人之一，他的作品深刻反映了中国社会的变革历程。作为现实主义文学的倡导者，他开创了中国现代长篇小说的新范式，特别是《子夜》被誉为中国现代文学的经典之作。茅盾不仅是一位杰出的作家，也是文学理论家、翻译家和文学活动家，为中国现代文学的发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。他坚持'为人生的艺术'，将文学与社会现实紧密结合，体现了知识分子的社会责任感。
supporter.en: Mao Dun is regarded as one of the foundational figures of modern Chinese literature. His works profoundly reflect China's social transformation. As a pioneer of realistic literature, he established new paradigms for the modern Chinese novel, with 'Midnight' considered a classic of modern Chinese literature. Beyond being an outstanding writer, Mao Dun was also a literary theorist, translator, and literary activist, making indelible contributions to the development of modern Chinese literature. He upheld the principle of 'art for life's sake,' closely connecting literature with social reality and embodying the social responsibility of intellectuals.

critic.zh: 茅盾的创作也存在一些局限。他的作品往往带有明显的政治倾向，有时为了表达政治理念而牺牲了艺术性。在后期创作中，特别是在社会主义建设时期，他的作品显得概念化，缺乏早期作品的深刻性和艺术感染力。此外，茅盾作为文学界领导人，在特定历史时期对一些作家的批判和处理方式也受到争议。他的文学理论虽然强调现实主义，但在实践中有时过于强调政治标准，忽视了文学的审美价值。
critic.en: Mao Dun's work has certain limitations. His writings often exhibit distinct political tendencies, sometimes sacrificing artistic merit to convey political messages. In his later works, particularly during the socialist construction period, they appear somewhat conceptualized, lacking the depth and artistic appeal of his earlier pieces. Additionally, as a leader in literary circles, his criticism and handling of certain writers during specific historical periods have been controversial. While his literary theory emphasized realism, in practice it sometimes prioritized political standards over aesthetic values.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和大众文化中，茅盾被定义为20世纪中国文学的重要代表人物。他的作品被纳入中国现代文学经典，成为研究中国现代社会变迁的重要文本。茅盾文学奖的设立使他的名字与中国文学的最高荣誉紧密相连。学术界对他的研究涵盖了文学创作、文学理论、翻译实践等多个领域。在流行文化中，茅盾的形象既是一位严肃的文学大师，也是一位关注社会现实的进步知识分子，他的生平和作品被广泛传播和研究，成为中国现代文化的重要符号。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Mao Dun is recognized as a key representative of 20th-century Chinese literature. His works are included in the canon of modern Chinese literature and serve as important texts for studying China's social transformation. The Mao Dun Literature Prize has cemented his name as synonymous with the highest honor in Chinese literature. Academic research on him spans multiple fields including literary creation, literary theory, and translation practice. In popular culture, Mao Dun is portrayed both as a serious literary master and a progressive intellectual concerned with social reality, with his life and works widely disseminated and studied as an important symbol of modern Chinese culture.

self.zh: 文学是反映社会现实的镜子，也是推动社会进步的武器。
self.en: Literature is both a mirror reflecting social reality and a weapon promoting social progress.

others.zh: 茅盾是中国现代文学史上的一座丰碑，他的作品不仅记录了一个时代的变迁，更展现了中国知识分子在历史洪流中的精神探索。
others.en: Mao Dun is a monumental figure in the history of modern Chinese literature; his works not only recorded the changes of an era but also showcased the spiritual exploration of Chinese intellectuals in the torrent of history.
